description: Source code for a reftable writer module, implementing functions for writing, flushing, and managing reftable data structures, including sections for references, logs, and object indices.

classes.name: obj_index_tree_node
classes.description: Data structure representing a node in the object index tree, containing a hash, offsets, and capacity info.

methods.name: writer_flush_block
methods.description: Flushes the current block to storage, handling padding and updating index records.

methods.name: writer_clear_index
methods.description: Clears the in-memory index of block references.

methods.name: writer_finish_section
methods.description: Finalizes a section by flushing blocks and writing multi-level index if needed.

methods.name: writer_dump_object_index
methods.description: Dumps the object index tree into the reftable as a series of object records.

methods.name: reftable_writer_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new reftable writer instance with provided write and flush functions.

methods.name: reftable_writer_set_limits
methods.description: Sets minimum and maximum update index limits for the writer.

methods.name: reftable_writer_close
methods.description: Finalizes and closes the writer, writing headers, footers, and cleaning up resources.
